name: Server blocks operations before the password is changed
title: SC-06-06-06 Server blocks operations before the password is changed
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given an authenticated session whose user must change the password
When the client calls any business endpoint
Then the server answers 403 with code "PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED"
And the client shows the password change screen
